comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
The chain quest follows after unlocking Xanadu:

#1 Quest: Mongolian Bow Technology (translated) (Chronoquest 14th Century)
Location: St. Petersburg adventure guild
Requirements: R10 search, R12 Appraisal and R10 Unlock
1. Talk with St.Petersburg Craftsman
2. Talk 4x with young man in Xanadu.
3. Observe and search in Xanadu (Treasure / Synhetic Bow).

#2 Quest: Culmination of bow research
Location: Amsterdam/London adventure guild
Requirement: Far Europe Language
1. Talk to St. Petersburg Craftsman.
2. Give 2 Leather to the Crafstman in Oslo then you get the bow.

Kind Regards,

Huseyin-Gazi
